title: Lipscomb men's golf receives academic honors and four earn All-America Scholar recognition - Nashville Standard
text:
Lipscomb men's golf receives academic honors and four earn All-America Scholar recognition
The Lipscomb Men's Golf program received Golf Coaches Association of America Presidents Special Recognition for the 2025-26 academic year, with four student-athletes named NCAA Division I Cobalt Golf All-America Scholars, according to an Aug. 5 announcement.
The GCAA recognized a record 331 schools across six divisions as recipients of the 2025-26 PLATFORM Golf Team Academic Award. This award is given to programs that achieved a cumulative team grade-point average of at least 3.0 during the academic year. Lipscomb was among just 155 programs nationwide to receive Presidents Special Recognition after posting a cumulative team GPA of 3.5 or higher.
Individually, senior Toby Bishop, graduate student Oakley Gee, senior Maxi Klaus and senior Minas Manias each earned NCAA Division I Cobalt Golf All-America Scholar honors for their achievements both on the course and in the classroom. Bishop concluded the academic year with a Bachelor of Science in Sport Management and a cumulative GPA of 3.89. Gee completed his Master of Business Administration while maintaining a perfect 4.00 GPA. Klaus earned his honor with a GPA of 3.81 while pursuing a Bachelor of Business Administration in Management, and Manias posted a GPA of 3.60 as he pursued his Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance.
The Cobalt Golf All-America Scholar program recognizes student-athletes who excel academically and athletically; nominees must be at least sophomores academically, compete in at least half their team's competitive rounds, maintain a stroke average below 76.0, and carry a cumulative grade-point average of at least 3.2.
The PLATFORM Golf Team Academic Award is presented to collegiate golf programs achieving at least a cumulative team GPA of 3.0 during the academic year; Presidents Special Recognition is reserved for those finishing with an outstanding cumulative team GPA above 3.5.
